subject: Re: Dedicated capacity follow-up — NovaBio sizing & next steps
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@novabio.com>, Michael Chen <michael.chen@novabio.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap — NovaBio dedicated capacity recommendations
Attachments: redwood-dedicated-quick-reference.pdf

Sarah / Michael — thanks again for taking the demo and the deep-dive today. Quick recap from my side and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Summary of pain and goals (from today's call):
- Latency sensitivity for counsel-chat endpoints: target p95 < 120 ms for 512-token responses.
- Data isolation and residency: model inputs must remain in NovaBio VPC; audit logs retained for 12+ months.
- Predictable throughput for scheduled batch inference (peak morning window 10–12 PST) and free-form interactive load the rest of the day.
- Compliance: procurement will need SOC2 evidence and encryption-at-rest + KMS integration.

Initial sizing recommendation (conservative starting pool):
- Reserved private pool: 4x H100-equivalent GPUs (single-tenant reserved capacity)
  - Expected steady-state throughput: ~120 concurrent users for interactive workloads, burst safely to shared pool when reserved capacity hits ceiling.
  - KV cache enabled for prefix-heavy workloads — reduces token compute for repeated prompts.
- Autoscale/burst: configure burst policy to allow up to +2x short-term capacity to handle spikes (billing billed to reserved account with capped burst).
- Target SLOs: p95 latency < 120 ms, p99 latency < 350 ms on reserved pool; SLA: 99.9% uptime for reserved capacity in scope.

Operational and security notes: 
- Private control plane + VPC peering recommended; we can provide an on-prem package if needed for air-gapped requirements.
- KMS integration supported (bring-your-own-key).
- We'll provide SOC2 Type II report and system architecture diagrams for procurement.

Proposed next steps / owners:
1) I will send a formal quote and a short checklist for procurement (action: Dylan — send by Mon 2/23).
2) Michael to confirm whether NovaBio procurement needs specific contract language for data retention and indemnities (action: Michael — confirm by Tue 2/24).
3) Technical deep-dive session to align on VPC details and KV cache patterns (action: Dev — schedule a 60-min session; target week of 2/29).
4) Grace to prepare pricing with a 12-month commit option and highlight any introductory discount we can offer (action: Grace).

If that aligns, I'll drop the quote and a procurement-ready bundle (SOC2, checklist, sample SOW) into the thread tomorrow.

Thanks — Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
D: +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@novabio.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Michael Chen <michael.chen@novabio.com>
Cc: NovaBio Procurement <procurement@novabio.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Feb 2026 09:43:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — NovaBio dedicated capacity recommendations

Thanks, Dylan — this is helpful and captures what we discussed. A couple of follow-ups from procurement/infra side: 

- Can you send a line-item monthly cost estimate for the 4x H100 reserved pool + burst pricing? Procurement will want a clear monthly committed fee vs burst usage.
- We need confirmation that audit logs (access + request logs) can be retained for 12 months and exported to our S3 (if needed).
- Data residency: we require all inference inputs/outputs to remain in our AWS account/VPC. Will your Private deployment option support that?

I added procurement on this thread. Michael (infra) — any red flags from your side? If not, procurement would like the formal quote and SOC2 report to start the purchase order.

Best,
Sarah Lewis
Head of Product Platforms | NovaBio

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Feb 2026 10:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — pricing/terms follow-up (internal)

Looping in here with proposed pricing approach and one ask from sales ops. Per the sizing Dylan recommended (4x H100 reserved):

- Pricing (starter 12-month commit): $85,000 / month committed for the reserved pool (includes 99.9% reserved SLA).
- Burst: billed at 1.6x the per-reserved-unit rate for short-term usage above committed capacity.
- Introductory discount: we can extend a 10% discount on the committed monthly fee for the first 6 months if NovaBio signs a 12-month commitment within 14 days. This helps get the deal over the line and gives procurement predictable economics.

Compliance pack to attach to the external quote: SOC2 Type II (redwood-soc2-report-2025.pdf), private-deploy checklist (redwood-private-deploy-checklist.docx), and the draft SOW.

Two asks for Dylan/Dev before sending externally: 
1) Confirm the KV cache behavior with their primary model (they mentioned heavy prefix reuse) and whether we can promise a hit-rate optimization session during onboarding.
2) Confirm the exact SLO wording we will include in the quote (we typically commit to 99.9% uptime for reserved pools; latency targets are best-effort but we can include p95 < 120 ms as an operational target with remediation playbook).

If you want, I can draft the commercial terms language to make procurement review simpler.

— Grace
GRACE O'CONNOR
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>

Attachments: redwood-novabio-dedicated-quote-20260223.pdf, redwood-soc2-report-2025.pdf, redwood-private-deploy-checklist.docx

Hi Sarah / Michael / Procurement team — attaching the formal quote and compliance bundle as requested. Highlights: 

- Committed option (recommended): 4x H100-equivalent reserved pool, private tenancy. Committed fee: $85,000 / month.
- Introductory offer: 10% off committed fee for first 6 months with a 12-month commitment (expires 3/9/2026).
- Burst policy: up to 2x short-term capacity; burst billed at 1.6x per-unit rate.
- SLA: 99.9% uptime for reserved pool. Latency target: p95 < 120 ms (operational target; remediation playbook included).
- Security: SOC2 Type II report attached and KMS integration supported. Audit logs can be exported to your S3.

Next steps (proposed timeline):
- Procurement review: please confirm any contract language needs by Thu 2/26.
- Technical deep-dive (VPC + KV cache): Dev to schedule a 60-min call for week of 2/29. Proposed slots: Tue 3/2 10am PT, Wed 3/3 2pm PT.
- If procurement approves, counter-sign SOW and we target provisioning in ~3 weeks after PO receipt.

I'll follow up to lock a technical slot. If procurement prefers a separate thread for legal, happy to move the quote there.

Thanks and happy to jump on a quick call if any of the terms need clarification.

Best — Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
